review_text: It's a trendy, nice place to unwind—I really like it. You must try their Chicken Caesar Sandwich; it's amazing! Their coffee is a must, too.

Honestly, this is one of the best—if not the best—coffee shops in Davao City. For a café that roasts their own coffee, they don't just stop at great brews, their food is surprisingly good and genuinely filling. Every visit feels worth it, whether you're there for a proper meal or just a really well-made cup of coffee. Highly recommended.

Dropped by Coffeecat on a Friday morning a little after 9:30 and there were no customers. The place looked clean and I was greeted by the staff. There were several workers behind the counter. I ordered a Spanish Latte for take out and when I got outside and sipped it I could taste the salt and knew they got my order wrong. Not a big deal and maybe she didn't hear me correctly. The tag on the cup said: Sea Salt Latte. It was good nonetheless and I enjoyed it. It's a big coffee shop and plenty of comfortable seating. It's worth a second try!
tried their matcha drink and its good. staff are polite and accommodating. went on a weekday afternoon after lunch and only a few people so its not crowded. always a fan of this cafe.
In fairness, lami ilang foods and drinks. I tried their matcha with coconut water for the first time, and it was impressive!

I love this coffee shop. It is quite and spacious. A good place for you to do some quick work on your laptop. They also provide electricity outlets for the customers- it's available for free. The food is satisfying and delicious. Serving size is also the right amount. The parking space is huge, no problem for guests. Just come in at the non-peak time and a space is available for your car.

Located at downtown area, the coffee shop looks spacious and clean, strictly following the guidelines on covid 19 imposed by government. Ambiance is cool, the menu has many choices, they have both indoor and outdoor seating, and is accessible to physically challenged people. The service is not so good for the kind of coffee shop, the staff who attended to us is not welcoming and friendly. I can't imagine her just dropped all three different coffee orders in one table even if I directed her who owns what..it appears to me that she wasn't delighted with our presence. Not a big deal, but in this times of stiff competition in the market, I think that good or exceptional service is essential. We have to always remember also the old phrase "that first impression lasts".

Food was average. I tried paying with card (other reviews say they accept credit card) but the cashier told me they only accept cash. Weird but ok. I paid for my order with cash at 12:41. They owed me 430 pesos for change but told me they didn't have change yet. They shouldn't accept orders if they are short on change. Other customers came in and ordered their food after me without any problems. By the time I finished my meal, they still didn't have change for me. The cashier was irritated and ignoring me when I said I have to leave soon. She finally gave me my change after 30 minutes of pestering her. I do not recommend this restaurant. It seemed like she was hoping I would leave before getting my change back. It's one thing to not accept credit card, but it's another to not provide change in a timely manner.

Here's one café to show up at back when you can scan just a handful….Less confusion then. I remember the YOGO was a hit. Been that long, yes…Yangchou quinoa fried rice was non-greasy but filling…Mango tamarind was refreshingly tangy. Always-pleasant staff at the counter. Squeaky-clean dining area. The messy Chicken caesar sandwich, Coconut macaroons, and creamy Malty Matcha were my light nibbles for the day. Morning impressions —— no doubt relaxing. Overall, food value worth the repeat. And security personnel here have dual duties too.

Bigger space, nice interior, more tables and a great variety of coffee and pastries. Coffee Cat is one of my most fave coffee shops in Davao. I loved their service here. Staff is very accommodating and alert. Tried their Yogurt here and I fell in love.

Their cafe latte is very good! I have the habit of testing drinks and food in town and I can really say that this is one of the best that I've tried in Davao. Also, their mango yogurt drink is a must-try! The strawberry yogurt drink is okay since I'm not very much a fan of the fruit. Packaging is also great. Ordered thru Grab. I haven't experienced any spill from all delivered drinks. Kudos! 👏🏽

Best yogurt I can find in Davao! The food choices are wide and they are really tasty and delicious! The place is nice, cozy and comfy. You can choose either cushioned chair, a high chair or a normal chair. The staffs are kind and welcoming. The place is not calming and serene, not a lot of noises unlike other coffee or tea or cafés Ive been to.

Nice cafe with great service , food (waffles,macaroons, pastry) and coffee. Ambiance is modern, chairs are padded some not. Overall it's A nice place to stop by and just chill, have a good coffee or a place to meet up with friends to catch up.

We liked the ambiance. Although it's a little hot inside, the place is relaxing and quiet. I ordered carbonara pasta (with Alfredo sauce and bacon). I was asked if I'd like to add grilled chicken. I wanted more bacon in my pasta but it was not an option as an add on so I said yes to the grilled chicken for 60php. It was 300php total. When it was served my carbonara doesn't have even one bacon tidbit in it. There's only 5 small pieces of grilled chicken I paid for 60php as the add on. When we asked the staff about it, we were told it was either bacon or chicken. I paid for the extra though. The Alfredo sauce tasted good so we just let it go. The Angry Harry pasta was ok too. It was the quality of the 7-8 small pieces of ham they used that ruined it. The staff who delivered the order shoved the dish on the other table. Next to our table. I didn't care for it until I saw other reviews on here that say the same thing 😔 Pasta - Good portion for 1 person

2023 update: Main reason for coming here is to try their frozen yogurt but i didnt know they only serve it starting 1pm :( so i had to get iced coffee and a cheesecake instead. the iced coffee was good. the cheesecake was okay. compared to my last review and visit, their service is now better and the place as well. will come back again another day after 1pm! (Old review from yearsssss ago): Mainit ang place idk gumagana naman ang aircon. Also, we asked for a cellophane or any container for the food para itake home nalang cause we didnt finish it pero they didnt have one. Lol.

Coffee Cat 🐈 Good location. Visible and welcoming signage ... Good decoration in eye relaxation colours inside. Magazines on the shelf for time spending on the wall to enjoyment of drinking coffee. Big Menu choices of food and coffee itself. Such surprising to see Durian coffee, ube colored cappuccino and matcha coffee... Good options for dining with rice pasta or with full menu. - 1 ⭐ What disappointed - service. For dine in received coffee in paper cups 🥤 for takeaway only. Also professionalism of a waitresses was far from the level. Just dropped all the coffee and desserts on the corner of the table.
Lots of choices of drinks, pastries and meals. The place has plenty of working tables but their wifi is not that fast. The bathroom is clean but there is no bidet iykwim. The staff are friendly.

Had a lovely breakfast with really good ice cappuccino. Atmosphere of the coffee shop is nice and friendly. Very clean and tidy inside, welcoming and friendly staff. Definitely will be back! Breakfast and coffee was 475php
One of my fave places to stay for long hours (especially sa sofa area). Super like their Spanish latte with oat milk 👍 sometimes it may get crowded pero laban lng.
quiet place. coffee is good and not that expensive. accessible to all

Ordered via Grab. Even before the pandemic my friends & I loved going to Coffee Cat, ordering coffee and sweets. I ordered the uji matcha latte and pesto pasta for myself and iced white mocha and bulgogi beef kimchi for my partner. We both really enjoyed our food. I will definitely continue ordering from here and hope to go in person soon.
One of the worst cappuccino in Davao. Overheated milk, no foam, 160 peso wasted.
A very clean and cozy place. It's perfect for a midday chill with your friends. They also cater to on the go professionals since you can use your laptops here and be able to charge them.

The food and service is good. They also have free wifi. However, the net speed is slow maybe because there are many people who connected when I got there. They also have many electric outlet so you can work here while enjoying a cup of coffee.

They have so many choices on the menu that it's difficult to pick one. I just want a plain Iced Coffee but not finding it on the menu and ended up getting a Tiramisu Coffee Jelly, which I think has a salty cheesy froth at the top. I liked it.

This place is really packed with customers that usually stays for more than an hour because of work or studying. If you're looking for a place with a fast wifi connection, this is not the one. The place usually doesn't have their wifi available for the customers. There are also alot of outlets/plugs in the area and alot of comfortable chairs to sit it. There are not alot of food choices available and their pastries are not really that good. But the place truly has a good ambiance.
This place is great for students studying and for professionals to have their informal meetings. The place is so cozy and spacious, the staff are also nice.

Amazing service and even better food! My pup Stewie and I felt so welcomed from the moment we arrived. Everything was delicious, the staff was super friendly, and the vibe was perfect. We'll definitely be back!
Absolutely love their cheesecake options, and the sea salt latte is delightful. Also couldn't resist their (Kid's) cookies 😆

The drinks and yogurt were good, but the internet was extremely slow. Definitely not ideal if you're looking for a place to work or study. Websites wouldn't even load, and some sockets didn't work either. If you have your own data, though, it's a nice spot to hang out. Hopefully, they can improve their internet connection and fix the sockets in the future.
Good tasting yoghurt. My only gripe is the fact that the inside of the serving is hollow, which makes its relatively steep price even less justifiable.
We arrived by 4 and most of the drinks we chose were sold-out. Nice place though, spacious.
Cozy ambience. Tasty dishes and desserts. The acoustics can be better. Costs as much as 250 per head.

A great experience I had in this place. Had some coffee and food with my friends and chat all night long. Although I only had a drink which was the Matcha Latte, it was really good. My friends ordered a lot of food which looked really good so I would definitely try on my next visit. The service was great as well since they bring the orders to you and as much as possible bus your finished plates to clean it up. The atmosphere was a perfect feel for people who just want to unwind and getaway from the hot weather we have. The place is great for people who want to work or study or also friends and family who want to talk and catch up. Overall, great place and worth coming back to 🙌.
Gave me wrong size of drink, instantly upsized the drink when I clearly ordered a smaller size. NO WIFI available.
Good place for a nice chat with friends/family. Good food. Closes earlier than other coffee resto at 11pm. Ample parking space. Great location.

Haven't tried the food yet but the seats are quite closer to each other. Needs to take some seats to have a more cozier vibe. Just a little bit space is enough.

Restroom is clean. Staff are nice. If seats are full they are usually from the nearby call center, students who come to study, and some people on business.

So we has to repeat our instructions and had to wait a few more minutes for them to transfer our drinks to their to go cups.

Just another Philippines cafe modeled on the worse cafe chain in the world - Starbucks. What I find amusing is all the young, pretentious Filipinos that frequent these soulless establishments. Eck! So sterile, boring and as always, no healthy snack food in the cabinet. Just cakes and enough sugary pukes to line the surface of the mars.

This place has the ambiance of a McDonald's and as you would expect families taking huge blocks of the comfortable seating that exist. Don't come here expecting anything more. Coffee is commercial quality as well.
Been here for more than a couple of times. Love the Uji Matcha and creme brûlée cheesecake. Has decent parking space too.

Their staffs are accommodating. Coffecat is a nice place to hangout or study your lessons. They accept many modes of payment like cash, credit or debit card and Gcash. Try their delicious coffee and pastries, now! Enjoy!
